## Load packages

```{r load, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#######################
# PREPARE ENVIRONMENT
#######################

rm(list = ls())

load.lib <- c("data.table","foreign","stargazer","devtools","stringi", "srvyr", "survey","tidyverse","gtools", "remote","installr","microdadosBrasil","ggplot2","viridis","hrbrthemes","WDI","dplyr", "arrow", "readxl","rio","writexl","dineq", "basedosdados", "httr", "haven", "openxlsx", "fixest", "readxl", "xtable")

install.lib <- load.lib[!load.lib %in% installed.packages()]
for(lib in install.lib) install.packages(lib,dependencies=TRUE)
sapply(load.lib, require, character=TRUE)
```

## CENSO

```{r census}
data_1991_raw <- read_parquet("D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/censo/1991/censo_1991_migracao_tratada_migrante_15_final.parquet") # só tem migrantes
data_1991_new <- data_1991_raw |> 
  mutate(uf_nascim = if_else(uf_nascim == 34, 35, uf_nascim))

data_1991_new$age_squared_sp <- data_1991_new$age_sp^2
data_1991_new <- data_1991_new[data_1991_new$income_sp_raw != 9999999, ]

# deflaciona para 2010
data_1991_new$rend_med_mensal_pc_1 <- ifelse(
  is.na(data_1991_new$income_sp_raw) | data_1991_new$income_sp_raw == 0,
  NA,
  data_1991_new$income_sp_raw / 4418.739003
)

data_1991_new$rend_med_mensal_pc_2 <- ifelse(
  is.na(data_1991_new$rend_med_mensal_pc_1) | data_1991_new$rend_med_mensal_pc_1 == 0,
  NA,
  data_1991_new$rend_med_mensal_pc_1*42.869474
)

data_1991_new$log_rend_med_mensal_pc_2 <- ifelse(data_1991_new$rend_med_mensal_pc_2 > 0, log(data_1991_new$rend_med_mensal_pc_2), NA)

names(data_1991_new)[names(data_1991_new) == "income_sp_raw"] <- "income_sp_raw_old"
names(data_1991_new)[names(data_1991_new) == "rend_med_mensal_pc_2"] <- "income_sp_raw"

data_1991_new$log_income_sp_raw <- ifelse(data_1991_new$income_sp_raw > 0, log(data_1991_new$income_sp_raw), NA)

data_1991_new <- data_1991_new[data_1991_new$children != 99, ]
```

## LFP

```{r pnad}
lfp_1970_30_49_uf <- read_xlsx("D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/lfp/censo_lfp_uf_30-49_1970.xlsx")

# Criar as novas linhas para MS (50) e TO (17) com os valores de MT (51) e GO (52)
novos_estados <- lfp_1970_30_49_uf %>%
  filter(uf_nascim %in% c(51, 52)) %>% # Seleciona MT e GO
  mutate(uf_nascim = ifelse(uf_nascim == 51, 50, 17)) # Substitui 51 → 50 e 52 → 17

# Adicionar os novos estados ao dataframe original
lfp_1970_30_49_uf <- bind_rows(lfp_1970_30_49_uf, novos_estados)


lfp_1970_30_49_uf <- lfp_1970_30_49_uf |> 
  rename(lfp_uf_30_49_1970 = lfp_uf_1970)

lfp_1970_30_39_uf <- read_xlsx("D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/lfp/censo_lfp_uf_30-39_1970.xlsx")
lfp_1970_30_39_uf <- lfp_1970_30_39_uf |> 
  rename(lfp_uf_30_39_1970 = lfp_uf_1970)

lfp_1970_40_49_uf <- read_xlsx("D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/lfp/censo_lfp_uf_40-49_1970.xlsx")
lfp_1970_40_49_uf <- lfp_1970_40_49_uf |> 
  rename(lfp_uf_40_49_1970 = lfp_uf_1970)

lfp_1970_mais_10_uf <- read_xlsx("D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/lfp/censo_lfp_uf_10-mais_1970.xlsx")
lfp_1970_mais_10_uf <- lfp_1970_mais_10_uf |> 
  rename(lfp_uf_mais_10_1970 = lfp_uf_1970)
```

## TFR

```{r tfr}
tfr_1940_1980_uf <- read_xlsx("D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/fecundidade_brasil/tfr_1940_1980.xlsx")
tfr_1970_uf <- tfr_1940_1980_uf |>
  dplyr::select(uf_nascim, tfr_1970)
```

## Urbanization rate

```{r urban rate}
urban_1970 <- read_xlsx("D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/infra/urban_1970.xlsx")

```

### junta bases

```{r junta bases}
data_1991_new <- merge(data_1991_new, lfp_1970_30_49_uf, by = "uf_nascim")
data_1991_new <- merge(data_1991_new, lfp_1970_30_39_uf, by = "uf_nascim")
data_1991_new <- merge(data_1991_new, lfp_1970_mais_10_uf, by = "uf_nascim")
data_1991_new <- merge(data_1991_new, lfp_1970_40_49_uf, by = "uf_nascim")

data_1991_new <- merge(data_1991_new, tfr_1970_uf, by = "uf_nascim")

data_1991_new <- merge(data_1991_new, urban_1970, by = "uf_nascim")

```

### desagrega

```{r desagrega}
data_30_49_1991 <- data_1991_new |> 
  filter(age_fem %in% c(30:49))
write_xlsx(data_30_49_1991, "D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/bases/census_1991_proxies_1970_30_49.xlsx")

data_30_39_1991 <- data_1991_new |> 
  filter(age_fem %in% c(30:39))
write_xlsx(data_30_39_1991, "D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/bases/census_1991_proxies_1970_30_39.xlsx")

data_40_49_1991 <- data_1991_new |> 
  filter(age_fem %in% c(30:39))
write_xlsx(data_40_49_1991, "D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/bases/census_1991_proxies_1970_40_49.xlsx")

rural_40_49 <- data_40_49_1991 |>
  filter(V1061 %in% c(4,5,6,8))
write_xlsx(rural_40_49, "D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/bases/census_1991_proxies_1970_40_49_rural.xlsx")

urbana_40_49 <- data_40_49_1991 |> 
  filter(V1061 %in% c(1,2,3))
write_xlsx(urbana_40_49, "D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/bases/census_1991_proxies_1970_40_49_urbana.xlsx")

rural_30_39 <- data_30_39_1991 |>
  filter(V1061 %in% c(4,5,6,8))
write_xlsx(rural_30_39, "D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/bases/census_1991_proxies_1970_30_39_rural.xlsx")

urbana_30_39 <- data_30_39_1991 |> 
  filter(V1061 %in% c(1,2,3))
write_xlsx(urbana_30_39, "D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/bases/census_1991_proxies_1970_30_39_urbana.xlsx")

rural_30_49 <- data_30_49_1991 |> 
  filter(V1061 %in% c(4,5,6,8))
write_xlsx(rural_30_49, "D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/bases/census_1991_proxies_1970_30_49_rural.xlsx")

urbana_30_49 <- data_30_49_1991 |> 
  filter(V1061 %in% c(1,2,3))
write_xlsx(urbana_30_49, "D:/1_migration/1_datasets_migrants/bases/census_1991_proxies_1970_30_49_urbana.xlsx")
```

### separa por estados

```{r separa por estados}
ufs <- c(51, 12, 35, 50, 42, 14, 13, 41, 28, 33, 43, 15, 17, 53, 52, 22, 31, 26, 24, 32, 21, 11, 29, 23, 25, 16, 27)

# Loop para criar um dataframe para cada UF na lista especificada
for (estado in ufs) {
  assign(paste0("data_", estado), data %>% filter(uf == estado))
}
```
